comparison_scope: Literal citation/context and predeclared numeric representation concordance only; no residual/error/rank comparisons or choosing the most favorable candidate.
minimum_conclusion: Stored numerical labels and citation can be inspected directly if present; no method-preference reexecution is required. Candidate source-location identity may remain ambiguous because no stable reference key is stored.
numeric_representation_caveat: Upstream TargetEntry/PropertyValue use float; original target JSON decimal spelling need not survive float serialization. Any exact numeric concordance rule must be declared before numerical inspection; no nearest-value or adaptive tolerance rule.
numeric_validation_caveat: Any later stored-label usability check must verify finite non-boolean numerical types directly; source float annotations and structural presence do not establish this.
preserved_annotation_caveat: bind_evidence appends the original property unchanged on unmapped or no selected target. Non-null stored reference fields alone therefore do not establish bound status or selection by this binder; pre-existing annotations may survive.
scientific_limits: Stored labels are archival records, not certified physical truth
No model checkpoint identity/hard discrepancy bound established
Input-hash agreement is not proof that stored prediction values were unchanged
A sole candidate match or apparent binding status is not source-rights/condition validation
No historical method policy is rerun to fill absent or ambiguous labels
